class.name: GameplayNetworkPrediction
class.brief_description: Godot MultiplayerPeer adapter for authoritative input and movement snapshots.
class.description: GameplayNetworkPrediction connects GF-5 prediction to the GF-2 session peer and optional GF-4 replication graph. The server reads the real transport sender, requires a spawned session, and accepts intent dictionaries only. Owner snapshots drive reconciliation; relevant non-owners receive interpolation samples. Unconfirmed client inputs are retried at a bounded interval so controlled loss eventually converges.

method.name: clear_transport
method.description: Detaches the peer and clears queued transport work without deleting registered movement objects.

method.name: configure_client
method.description: Attaches a client peer.

method.name: configure_server
method.description: Attaches an authority peer and session source.

method.name: get_last_rejection_reason
method.description: Returns the latest packet or authority rejection reason.

method.name: get_network_simulator
method.description: Returns the controlled outgoing-network adapter.

method.name: get_owned_client_object
method.description: Returns an owner predictor registered on a client.

method.name: get_rejected_packet_count
method.description: Returns rejected prediction packets, including duplicates retried after a lost confirmation.

method.name: get_remote_client_object
method.description: Returns a remote interpolation buffer registered on a client.

method.name: get_replication_graph
method.description: Returns the optional server relevancy source.

method.name: get_server_object_state
method.description: Returns an authoritative state on the server adapter.

method.name: handles_message
method.description: Returns whether the dictionary is a GF-5 input or snapshot envelope.

method.name: is_server
method.description: Returns the configured role.

method.name: peer_disconnected
method.description: Discards delayed packets and graph state for a disconnected server-side peer.

method.name: poll
method.description: Schedules client retries and sends due simulated packets.

method.name: receive_packet
method.description: Validates and consumes a prediction envelope using the actual transport sender.

method.name: register_owned_client_object
method.description: Registers the locally owned object that receives correction snapshots.

method.name: register_remote_client_object
method.description: Registers a non-owned object that receives relevant interpolation samples.

method.name: register_server_object
method.description: Registers one authority object.

method.name: set_replication_graph
method.description: Sets the graph whose current relevant sets select remote snapshot recipients.

method.name: set_network_simulator
method.description: Sets a non-null controlled outgoing-network adapter.

method.name: set_server_object_owner_peer_id
method.description: Rebinds an authority object after verified reconnect.

method.name: submit_local_input
method.description: Predicts and queues one owner input, or returns null when rejected.

members.member: Retry interval for unconfirmed owner inputs.
